# Oakville Place Dental

> A comprehensive dental practice in Oakville offering emergency, general, family, cosmetic, and specialized dentistry with advanced digital technologies.

Oakville Place Dental is a full-service dental office led by Dr. Steven Solomon and Dr. Nasser Derakhshan, featuring state-of-the-art technology including CEREC CAD/CAM, Itero scanners, and Invisalign treatments. The practice serves patients of all ages with a focus on preventative care, cosmetic enhancements, and emergency services.

## Cosmetic & Restorative Dentistry

- [Cosmetic Dentistry Services Oakville - Oakville Place Dental](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry-services-in-oakville): Cosmetic dentistry including teeth whitening, veneers, and crowns.
- [Teeth Whitening Service Oakville | Oakville Place Dental](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/teeth-whitening-bleaching-service-in-oakville): Professional teeth whitening and bleaching services with in-office and at-home options.
- [Dental Prosthodontics Implants Oakville - Oakville Place Dental](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/dental-prosthodontics-oakville): Dental implants, prosthodontics, crowns, and bridges using titanium technology.
- [Invisalign Treatments in Oakville - Oakville Place Dental Office](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/invisalign-oakville): Invisalign clear aligner treatments with 3D imaging technology for teeth straightening.

## Specialized Treatments

- [Children's Dentist Oakville | Oakville Place Dental Office](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/childrens-dentistry-oakville): Pediatric dentistry services with anxiety relief and painless procedures for children.
- [Endodontic Treatment in Oakville | Oakville Place Dental Office](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/endodontic-treatment-in-oakville): Root canal therapy and endodontic treatment to preserve infected or decaying teeth.
- [Periodontist in Oakville - Oakville Place Dental Office](https://www.dentistoakville.com/services/periodontist-oakville): Periodontal care, gum surgery, and dental implants with osseointegration technology.
